text: Photos of the venue and lobby of the Ado National Tour 2023 "Mars" held at Nippon Budokan on August 29 (Tue.) and 30 (Wed.), 2023, are now available. The fastest report of the entire Ado National Tour 2023 "Mars" will be updated after the tour. Please be forewarned.

On both Tuesday, August 29 and Wednesday, August 30, we had a very large turnout. Since it was extremely hot in Tokyo, where the Nippon Budokan is located, many of the participants were wearing parasols to protect themselves from the heat. Even so, the heat was hard to beat, and everyone was sweating and drinking water as they gathered for the start of the merchandise sales. The heat is forecasted to continue, so we hope that you will take measures against the heat and drink plenty of water at the Osaka-jo Hall and Yokohama Arena venues to be held in the near future. Costumes for "Kigeki," "Kampanella," and "Mirage" will be on display at the show, as well as an Adoart exhibit. The "Mars" banner was already displayed in the Budokan on the morning of Tuesday the 29th. As for the merchandise sales, there were no crowds because QR codes were issued in advance for the queue arrangement on both days. Therefore, it seemed to be very smooth to purchase goods. In particular, "Cheki-style trading cards" and goods featuring "Hachan," whose animation was recently released, were very popular. The Gacha Gacha booth was also very crowded. It seemed like everyone was always trying to get into the machine. It was very impressive to see people cheering with joy when they got the goods they were looking for, and the booths were always very lively. The "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" booth was also very busy. The uchiwa fans, which we have been handing out since the Nippon Budokan concert, were especially popular, and many visitors took pictures with them. Many of the visitors drew the "Ado-mikuji" lottery, hoping for a "kyoku (bad luck)," but it was very impressive to see the smiles on everyone's faces no matter which lottery ticket came out. We started selling "Ad rosa tolmarie" goods from the Nippon Budokan concert. Many customers lined up before the sale every day, and the various plush toys were very popular. Also, we felt that there were many customers who immediately attached the "ear-shaped patch clasp" they had purchased to the live performance. By the way, if you were lucky, you might be able to meet "Ad rosa tolmarie"... Thank you very much for your cooperation in organizing the line at the entrance while suppressing your excitement before the opening time. The booths were also very busy. After the show, many visitors took commemorative photos with the Budokan in the background with their penlights flashing in blue. It was a beautiful sight to see from the outside. Thank you very much for coming to the Nippon Budokan on both days.

text: Ado's new song "DIGNITY" will be the theme song for the movie "The Armada of Silence". The new song "DIGNITY" was written by B'z, with lyrics by Hiroshi Inaba and music by Takahiro Matsumoto, and is titled "DIGNITY". B'z, which celebrates its 35th anniversary this year and has sung theme songs for many movies and given great color to each movie, is the first Japanese artist to provide music for Ado, whose voice has captivated all who hear it with its delicate yet bold vocal expression. This is the first time that B'z, who has sung the theme song for many films and given great color to each film, has provided a song for a Japanese artist. The song is a tragic, beautiful, solemn, and vital ballad linked to the worldview of the film. It is a magnificent song that accompanies the quiet anguish of the main character, Kaieda, and the dignity of the characters' destiny, which extends even in the film. Ado's powerful yet gentle voice and B'z's magnificent and deep music create a wonderful chemical reaction, which we hope you will enjoy.

Silence of the Fleet" is a hit comic by Kaiji Kawaguchi, which was serialized in "Morning" (Kodansha) from 1988 to 1996 and has sold more than 32 million copies (paper and electronic). The announcement of the live-action film adaptation attracted a great deal of attention both in Japan and abroad. At the time of its serialization, the comic's sharply taboo subject matter caused controversy in various quarters, and it was even discussed in the Diet. The film will be released in theaters as a one-of-a-kind action-political entertainment film that raises the sincere issue of "how to achieve world peace through nuclear deterrence" in a surprising storyline with spectacular undersea combat action and profound political suspense.

Starring Takao Osawa, who also serves as producer for this film, he has been working enthusiastically on the production, including building a cooperative framework with the Ministry of Defense and the Maritime Self-Defense Force, and presenting the project to the original author, Kawaguchi.

Directed by Kohei Yoshino, winner of numerous awards including the Japan Academy Award for Best Director for "Haken Anime! (2022), which won numerous awards including the Japan Academy Prize for Best Director. (2022). Production is by Credeus, which has produced many hit films such as "Kingdom" and "Gintama". The film is the first Japanese film to be shot with the cooperation of the Maritime Self-Defense Force's submarine unit, and combines the best VFX technology in Japan to create a highly realistic visual experience. The film presents a realistic visual experience by combining an actual submarine, filmed for the first time with the cooperation of the Maritime Self-Defense Force's submarine unit, and some of Japan's best VFX technology. The film tackles a forbidden theme, as if to sound an alarm about the wavering "nuclear international order.

I am truly delighted to be in charge of the theme song for the movie "The Armada of Silence".

Hiroshi Inaba

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the two members of B'z for creating and providing the wonderful music for the film "The Armada of Silence," and to Mr. Ado for adding color to the film with his powerful singing voice. text: Ado has previously stated the following in the media. I set up my microphone and equipment in my closet and sing in there. What is "Ado's Closet" where many "I tried singing in it" were born, how big is it, and how would you feel if you were to actually enter the closet to record a song? The stage was set in 2023. The stage was set for the Nico Nico Super Conference 2023 held at Makuhari Messe on April 29 (Sat.) and 30 (Sun.), 2023, where "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" was exhibited as a booth, a photo spot and recording booth, at this major Nico Nico cultural event.

Before the doors opened...I took this picture of the entire booth when no visitors had arrived yet. The entrance to "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" was clearly visible from a distance, and three closets lined up in the back of the booth. Here is a view of the actual closets and the equipment installed in them. Behind the booth, there was a huge 2D "Ado-chan" and mysterious posters were displayed everywhere in the venue. When the doors opened at 10:00 a.m. on both days of the Nico Nico Ultra Conference, many visitors came to the recording booth. We are very grateful to the many people who came to our booth for the purpose of visiting our booth. There were also people who were interested in joining us on the day of the event. The "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" booth looked like this from the entire Nico Nico Superconference venue. It was very impressive to see how many people were taking detailed photos of the photo spot booth. In particular, I got the impression that many people were surprised at the size of the closet. The recording booth was linked to the radio project "Ado's Backstage" and held the "Teach us Ado-chan! was held in conjunction with the radio project "Ado's Backstage". Many people were thrilled to find out that Ado was recording in almost the same booth as this one. It was also impressive to see how most of them were very nervous, but were trying their best to think of what they wanted to ask or tell Mr. Ado, and to record the session. Some of the guests took very nice pictures at the photo spot booth, and some of them wanted to be recorded with that person at the recording booth. On the day of the event, we handed out the following flyer to everyone who came to Nico Nico Ultra Conference 2023. The back of the flyer was a puzzle. Actually, Kochira...only this part did not have a Nico Nico Chan. It might have been very difficult to find a mistake...
Thank you to everyone who visited the "Ado's Doki Doki Secret Base" booth at the Nico Nico Ultra Conference 2023. We hope you will continue to enjoy "Ado's Doki Doki Secret Base" in the future.

text: Photos of the venue and lobby of the Ado National Tour 2023 "Mars" held on September 16 and 17, 2023, at Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa, Japan, are now available. The fastest report of the entire Ado National Tour 2023 "Mars" will be updated at a later date. Please be forewarned.

On September 16 (Sat.) and 17 (Sun.), a large number of guests gathered at Yokohama Arena for the final performance of "Mars. The weather was fine on both days, and although it was mid-September, the temperature was over 30 degrees Celsius, making both days very hot and humid. Fortunately, all the booths were located in the lobby of the Yokohama Arena, so we were able to enjoy some relief from the heat. In addition to the performances at the Nippon Budokan and Osaka-jo Hall, the "Kigeki," "Kampanella," and "Mirage" costume and Adoart displays were also held at the Yokohama Arena, including this show. We are sorry for the inconvenience. Please understand that this is a work that was actually enjoyed by the visitors. Saturday, September 16th, Yokohama Arena, in the morning, was another fine day. Except for a few performances, the tour with "Mars" was blessed with good weather. Also, it rained or met with torrential rain at some performances, but on some days the rain stopped before the doors opened or after the show, and we had to think that the weather was also overwhelmed by the power of the visitors who came to the show and recovered, etc. ■On both days, a very large number of visitors gathered early in the morning prior to the opening of each booth. At the Yokohama Arena, we had visitors line up in a single week around the perimeter of the site, which must have been very difficult from the morning, but there was no confusion, and they lined up in the guide lines for each booth. Thank you very much for your cooperation and support during the whole day. There seemed to be no big crowds or congestion in the venue even though everyone entered the venue according to the QR code issued. This may be the reason why there were many customers who were examining and purchasing goods. Especially, many customers purchased a lot of goods at one time because the show was coming to its final performance at "Mars". On both December 16 and 17, there was a CD sales booth next to the merchandise booth. This booth was crowded with customers who pre-ordered "Ado no Utattemita Album", which will be released on December 13, 2023, at Yokohama Arena. ■Gacha-gacha booth was especially popular with many people all the way from before to after the show. Many people were playing with the gachacha in large quantities, and were happy, disappointed, and full of joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure as they opened the gacha cases with their friends. The "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" booth was also very busy. The "Uchiwa" (fan) was very popular again this year, and many people used it every day after it was handed over to them. The Ado lottery was also a great success, with many visitors enjoying the lottery and the staff having fun together. The "Ado Rosatormally" booth had a long line of people waiting for the goods even before the start of the sales. The popular plush toys were sold out quickly, but the "AdRosa Tolmaly" walked around the venue again and again, greeting everyone. Will we see her again somewhere in the future? ■■ Also, at the Yokohama Arena concert, we displayed the "Ado's Closet Booth" that was reproduced at this year's Cho-Kaigi. Many people stopped by to check out the equipment and take pictures. On both days, many visitors were outside the venue before the doors opened, and after the doors opened, there was a huge crowd in the lobby. After the show, there were many people taking pictures outside the venue with penlights in their hands. The blue light was fantastic in some places, and it was a very beautiful scenery. Thank you very much for coming to the Yokohama Arena concert and all the "Mars" performances.

text: (*I wrote what I wanted to say in the heat of the moment, and the blog has turned into a blog with two or three different contents. I know it is very difficult to read, but if you like it, please go to ......↓)
There are many things I would like to say, but first, I would like to apologize for not updating the blog and other content.
I would appreciate it if you could wait a little longer so that I can create an environment and time for myself to be able to deliver again, etc.

Thank you very much Mars. It's been two months, but now I feel as if I've done it a year ago. I'm grateful for the fact that I've been able to keep myself that busy, but a year is a bit of an exaggeration.
And then I realized it was the 3rd anniversary of my major debut.

I looked back at my tweets at the time, and I saw that I had announced by saying "that ...... will be my major debut ......". It was a very hokey way of making an announcement. I think people at that time believed me very well. (I wonder if there are still people who have been supporting us since then.)

The moment I made my major debut, I jumped on my bed. And the next day I jumped again. I think I repeated the move several times that year, like at the end of the year. (I don't remember if I jumped over the year.)

And even though I wrote about my feelings very carefully on the first and second anniversaries, the third anniversary is the most depressing and pathetic. I want to show everyone that my clothes are that messy (I deserve it) (even though it is so easy to make a mess*).
I'm glad I didn't continue to be called Ugly, Graduated, Mr. Ugly, or Abo.
Debuted on the last day of my 17th year, which means my birthday is next, so it's my birthday(?).

I remember last year very clearly. We received the unprecedented gift of fireworks on the day of the event, and you had a big festival by yourself, announcing various announcements and making a big fuss.
And I remember well how I logged out of Twitter the next day in a very fashionable cafe in Harajuku, surrounded by madams, feeling depressed all by myself. (Please guess why I was depressed ♡ ♫)
On the contrary, I am now thankful that it was a dense and even more unforgettable year.
This was probably not said on the front page,
The truth is, I didn't want to be 20 at the time and I cried gerska peek-a-boo every day.

It is as if the past is becoming more and more past, as if the days of fun and dreams are becoming more and more separated from the present, as if I have to go on alone in a big fog, as if something suddenly pushes me back and I step out of the white line and can't go back, as if the back of an adult has been pushed back. I had been looking up at the back of an adult for a long time, but now I am no longer a child, and I have to be in the same position of being looked at,
I was filled with all sorts of negative emotions. I was trying to somehow resist the time itself, even though it would definitely follow me even if I ran away from it. ......
To summarize, during the period of my 20th birthday, I was more "lonely" than "happy".
And I am even more embarrassed by this,
Even when I went from 20 to 21, I was still gaaaaskaapeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee! Aaaaahhhhhhhhhhhh, pathetic.

Why ...... No, but I'm pretty attached to the past. ......1 The moment when I feel that the present and the past are being torn apart is my "birthday," when I get older, so I guess I'll miss it. I think I'm going to miss it. I think I will be lonely. What the heck... I'm talking about myself, but I don't really understand the mechanism that triggers this to happen.
I'm sure it'll be the same next year. I'm starting to hate myself now (such as I am).

I am very scared to think that those days are no longer mine. I am sad to think that the days when my parents would carry me around on their backs are far gone again. I am sad to think that the time when I was able to use my immaturity as a weapon, when I was able to think that I was just a little bit amazing, when I could lie in my uniform in a closet with no heating, or look out the window of my room at the ocean created by the city, when I was able to see the future and the dreams I could see because I was still immature have all been badly beautified, and their shapes are changing. It is painful to think that all my dreams and future that I was able to see because I was still immature have been badly beautified and are changing in a strange way and becoming distant from "now".
But, at best, it is a blessing to be afraid. To feel that things are going to be different is to try to know the future, in other words, to try to live.
At best, yes, but at worst, it's an abandonment of choice. I've also put it off, which is an abandonment of self-love. ......
I said I would go to the world with Mars. Of course I will achieve it. And I am aware of the fact that I am not good enough to achieve it.
You're going to the world, what are you going to do?
I have to admit that I have a lot on my mind right now, with the harsh voices above good intentions, the pressure exuding from near and within me, and the lack of competence and time,
I feel I can truly love myself when I overcome and achieve that.
The road to self-love is very far. The reason why the goal of self-love is there is a bit hard to say yet.

We do what we say we will do. That is how I have been doing my activities so far, and I will be desperate until my ability is up to it. I may even make desperate appeals from time to time. At that time, think "I've lost my savings for approval and want to be cared for. ......" and laugh.
I haven't changed what I do in the last year or even now as far as around my birthday,
We do not intend to maintain the status quo with respect to our activities, and we hope that you will continue to look forward to Ado in the future.

Because I am running alone in my busy days, I sometimes forget those days, I don't have a best friend to tap me on the shoulder and remind me, and Ado is alone, so I am still very lonely, but I guess it is thanks to Vocalo that I can still somehow believe in the future.
I will continue to watch my most favorite movies, read manga, admire the scenery, and listen to Vocaloids,
I will continue to make my wishes come true for myself, while remembering the feelings I had back then when I kept dreaming of my dreams.
And I will do my best to be as useful and helpful to others as possible, to make up for the uselessness and laziness of my life up to now.
Please take care of yourselves as well.

text: The long-awaited second original album "Zanmu" (read: Zanmu), the first since "Kyogen" released in 2022, will be released on July 10. The jacket for this album was also created by ORIHARA, a painter who also serves as Ado's image director, and was released today in advance of the regular edition only. The album jacket is a composition of Ado looking up at something through a large window, as if peeking out from behind. The light reflecting off the window and illuminating Ado may represent his many thoughts and dreams, things he has seen from the past to the present, and at the same time, things he has left behind in the time that has passed.

The album "Zanmu" includes many tie-in songs such as "Sho", a big hit song performed at the Kohaku Uta Gassen, which was their first appearance last year; "Kurakura", the opening theme song for Season 2 of the anime "SPY x FAMILY"; "Mukohiroi", the theme song for the TBS drama "18/40 ~Futari nara Yume mo Koi mo~"; and "Chocolat Katabura", the first release in 2024 for Lotte Chocolate 60th anniversary commercial song "Chocolacatabla" and many other tie-up songs, as well as new unreleased recordings. The Limited Edition: BIG Acrylic Stand & Blu-ray disc, Limited Edition: Blu-ray disc, and DVD disc will include the live footage of the Los Angeles concert of THE FIRST WORLD TOUR "Wish", which astonished and delighted the whole world. The DVD and Blu-ray editions include live footage from the Los Angeles show.

Pre-orders are available from today, and those who pre-order at the venue of Ado SPECIAL LIVE 2024 "Heart" at National Stadium on April 27 & 28 will receive a hologram sticker (B6) as a limited bonus, and those who pre-order at CD stores and web stores nationwide by April 29, 10:00 will receive a postcard as an early pre-order bonus. If you pre-order at CD shops and web shops nationwide by 10:00 on April 29, you will receive a postcard as a special bonus.
Ado comment.

We have released "Kyogen", "Uta no Uta ONE PIECE FILM RED", and "Ado no Utattemita Album" so far, but this is surprisingly only our second original album, and we hope you will enjoy Ado's world view, which has become more powerful since our first album.
Zanmu" is a real word,
A dream that never ends. A dream that remains in your mind even after you wake up. It has the meaning of "a dream that remains in your mind even after you wake up.
I have always loved this word and thought it represented the dreams I have fulfilled in my life and the youth that did not come true.

I have been working alone for a long time, and I have a sad feeling inside me that many things have become the past, beautified as the past, and shining brightly, but at the same time, I want Ado's existence, songs, songs, vocaloids, singers, and everyone who listens to the album to be a dream that remains in your heart...
